notes: Ten defects a real aaPanel deployment found in one evening, and the gate that would have found them: Apache with PHP-FPM, a browser install driven end to end, and a PHP whose Argon2 comes from libsodium. Fixes a 500 on every page under PHP-FPM, a webroot that served deploy/, docs/ and .git, an uploads/ directory that executed PHP, an installer that died creating the administrator, an Authorization header Apache never passed on, an agent that refused to start while waiting for approval, and a Windows clash check that refused the overlay because of the agent’s own adapter.
